title: Neural Pushforward Samplers for the Fokker-Planck Equation on Embedded Riemannian Manifolds
summary: In this paper, we extend the Weak Adversarial Neural Pushforward Method to the Fokker--Planck equation on compact embedded Riemannian manifolds. The method represents the solution as a probability distribution via a neural pushforward map that is constrained to the manifold by a retraction layer, enforcing manifold membership and probability conservation by construction.
